<div class="page-intro">
This is a selection of interactive web applications I’ve built, with an emphasis on data visualization, exploratory data analysis, and user-driven interaction. Feel free to contact me at ajay [dot] sharma [at] berkeley [dot] edu for any comments or questions.
</div>

<div class="app-box">

## S&P 500 Investment Simulator

<a class="app-link" href="https://ajay-sharma.shinyapps.io/InvestmentSimulator/" target="_blank">Explore the Simulator</a>

<div class="quick-box"><strong>Summary:</strong> Monte Carlo–powered tool for visualizing S&amp;P 500 growth scenarios.</div>

<ul class="app-details">
  <li>View historical S&amp;P 500 closing prices (1928–2023) on linear or log scales.</li>
  <li>Customize date ranges with an intuitive slider.</li>
  <li>Run hundreds or thousands of simulations by specifying initial investment, periodic contributions, expected return, volatility, and time horizon.</li>
  <li>Compare percentile-based outcomes (10th, 25th, median, 75th, 90th) and summary statistics to assess risk and reward.</li>
</ul>

</div>

<div class="app-box">

## California Crash Data Explorer

<a class="app-link" href="https://ajay-sharma.shinyapps.io/app3/" target="_blank">Open the Explorer</a>

<div class="quick-box"><strong>Summary:</strong> Interactive dashboard for 2021–2022 California traffic-collision data.</div>

<ul class="app-details">
  <li>Filter crashes by county, severity, violation type, and hour of day using dropdowns and sliders.</li>
  <li>Visualize trends with bar charts (yearly counts, weekday patterns) and interactive Leaflet maps with clustered markers.</li>
  <li>Drill into individual incidents via a searchable data table showing location, severity, and violation category.</li>
</ul>

</div>

<div class="app-box">

## Harry Potter Text Sentiment Analysis

<a class="app-link" href="https://ajay-sharma.shinyapps.io/app2/" target="_blank">Launch the Text Analysis</a>

<div class="quick-box"><strong>Summary:</strong> Sentiment &amp; TF-IDF analysis across all seven Harry Potter books.</div>

<ul class="app-details">
  <li>Compute TF-IDF scores to identify the most distinctive terms per chapter or book, with options to include/exclude stopwords.</li>
  <li>Run multiple lexicons (Bing, NRC, Afinn, Loughran) to chart emotional tone and intensity across the series.</li>
  <li>Interactive bar charts and tables let you compare sentiment by chapter/book and dive into the key words driving each score.</li>
</ul>

</div>
